description: Supports applications for city medical financial assistance and the Social Case Study Report or endorsement required by hospitals, charitable institutions, and partner organizations.
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor / City Social Welfare and Development Office
whoMayAvail: Indigent residents of the City of Meycauayan and qualified people's organizations
steps: Answer the questions during the intake interview.
Wait while the Social Case Study Report and endorsement letter are prepared.
Receive the Social Case Study Report and endorsement letter.
requirements: Barangay Certificate of Indigency or Residency (original)
Valid government-issued ID of the client or beneficiary (photocopy; three specimen signatures where required)
Referral letter (original), if referred by another office or organization
Medical Abstract or Medical Certificate issued within the last 3 months (original and 1 photocopy)
Latest Hospital Bill or Statement of Account issued within the last 3 months (original and 1 photocopy)
Quotation for dialysis (original and 1 photocopy), if applicable
Quotation for surgery (original and 1 photocopy), if applicable
Quotation for orthopedic implants, such as locking plates or screws (original and 1 photocopy), if applicable
Treatment Protocol (original and 1 photocopy), if applicable
Drug Prescription or Reseta (original and 1 photocopy), if applicable
Laboratory Request or Referral (original and 1 photocopy), if applicable
Valid IDs of the patient and representative

service: Anti-Rabies Vaccination for Walk-In Dog/Cat Owners
description: Registers and vaccinates eligible dogs and cats against rabies in support of Republic Act No. 9482 and a rabies-free Meycauayan City.
steps: Create or present the required online registration account and bring the dog or cat, a valid ID, and an active smartphone/SIM.
Assist in safely restraining the pet during assessment and vaccination.
Receive the vaccination record and post-vaccination instructions.
requirements: Smartphone with an active SIM for online registration
Dog or cat to be vaccinated
Valid government-issued ID of the client

detailedRequirements.requirement: Smartphone with an active SIM for online registration
Dog or cat to be vaccinated
Valid government-issued ID of the client

clientSteps.action: Bring the pet and valid ID, then present or create the required online registration account.
Assist in restraining the pet while veterinary personnel assess it for vaccination.
The vaccine is administered and the vaccination record is completed.
Receive the vaccination record and post-vaccination instructions.

processingTime: Approximately 50 minutes, excluding queueing and clinical assessment
